text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Fan Fest is here, and the
central
plaza is bustling with people.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well, well. Someone's having a good
time.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hehe. My street clothes suit me, right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I was actually planning to enter one of
the sports
events, seeing as it's spring
and all...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
But one of my friends on the events
committee
begged me to join the Miss
Tracen competition.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Snagging the number one spot isn't
easy, you
know.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Not only are they making me give a
speech about
racing, they're also
checking my fashion sense!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'm always up for a challenge. This
contest
suits me to a T!
choice_data_list: But you seem kind of motivated.
But you seem pretty motivated, huh.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
No way! You're going for Miss Tracen
too,
Scarlet?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Curren?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Awww... Well there go my chances.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, little old me, up against Scarlet?
So not
happening.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I never stood a chance from the start.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
When they said to come in our "usual
clothes," I
thought they meant our
school uniform!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hehe... I'm such a dum-dum. No matter how much I try for the Grand Prix, I'll never get there... Sniff.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Sniff... You're so kind.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. Now my heart's full of warm
fuzzies!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: So... Umm...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I know this is kinda sudden, but can I ask
you for
a teensy little favor?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Can you vote for me for Miss Tracen? I
feel like I
could really give my all if I
knew you were
cheering for me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She pleads with me with eyes full of
tears. Those
eyes... I've got to help her.
I've got to!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thanks! See ya round! ♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: What are you blushing over, idiot?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Yes. You. Are!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! Really! Whose trainer do you think
you are?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You're supposed to help me become number one! In everything! Including the Miss Tracen contest!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet seems strangely worked
up as she enters the Miss Tracen
Academy contest. Eventually, the time
comes to announce the
results.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
The shining star of this year's Grand Prix
is...
Curren Chan!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You have got to be kidding.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
That's nice of you to say and all, but...
Ugh! I
can't believe I only got second
place...
choice_data_list: I thought you were number one.
I think you were number one.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I just don't get how I lost...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet's defeat leaves her feeling
down for
a while.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
The shining star of this year's Grand Prix
is...
Daiwa Scarlet!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! ♪ Thank you for your support,
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure to shine even brighter for
all of you!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! See? I can break out the charm
when I try!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Haha! ♪ Exactly! I'm the top
Umamusume in the
academy!
choice_data_list: Just what you'd expect from the nu...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Why would you look at anyone else
when you've
got me right here?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Really now? I wonder.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I'm wiped. I need to recharge
with
something sweet.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer. Buy me some cake.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Yes, you. That's not a problem, is it?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
When Tracen Academy's top
Umamusume asks
you to do something,
you should be grateful!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I treat Daiwa Scarlet to some celebratory
cake.
